representation: common-xy-v1; same six/seven compatibility slots; node detection flags, global detection flags and height fixed zero; age uses finite XY availability only; no fitted normalization, identity, event or target inputs
spatial: one cross-team SAB, width32/four heads, row FF64, shared two-seed PMA per team, output128; same TCN and heads as DeepSets
training: IDSSE only, same four training matches and exact 12+8 epoch schedule as Phase6 binary; no SkillCorner fitting; same initial TCN/heads, dropout RNG, ordering and ball corruption for both encoders
selection: one independent calibration match for Platt event calibration; one validation match for decoder selection; neither participates in weights or priors; all selections frozen before any new test predictions
skillcorner_development: first four lexicographically sorted public match keys, frozen before new scores; causal metadata audit only
skillcorner_confirmation: remaining sixteen sorted public keys; never used for training, calibration or architecture selection in Phase7; cohort already explored in Phase6, not a pristine research holdout
primary_comparison: fixed HMM strength0.5; secondary identical internal decoder selection grid (fixed HMM/HSMM or Platt candidate bonuses strength0.5)
architecture_rule: compare robust own-validation objective averaged over two pilots before test; Set Transformer promoted only if mean gain >=0.01, neither occlusion mean loses >0.02 and long-spell recall mean loses <=0.03
expansion: two pilots only; no automatic seven-fold search; external tests are exploratory evidence, not architecture selection
official_assets: prohibited; allow only public data/external paths and external report artifacts
